It is a subsidiary of Coffee Day Enterprises Limited. Internationally, CCD is present in Austria, the Czech Republic, Malaysia, Nepal, and Egypt. ==History== Café Coffee Day Global Limited Company is a [[Chikkamagaluru]]-based business that grows coffee in its own estates of 20,000 acres.{{cite web|url=http://business.in.com/article/big-bet/vg-siddhartha-is-branching-out/26282/0|title=Forbes India Magazine – V.G. Siddhartha is Branching Out|access-date=9 July 2001|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111008092739/http://business.in.com/article/big-bet/vg-siddhartha-is-branching-out/26282/0|archive-date=8 October 2011|url-status=dead}} It is the largest producer of [[Arabica coffee|arabica]] beans in Asia, exporting to various countries including U.S., Europe, and Japan.{{cite news |title=Full of beans |url=http://www.telegraphindia.com/1140403/jsp/you/18146793.jsp |date=3 April 2014 |agency=The Telegraph |location=Calcutta |access-date=Jul 25, 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140729173913/http://www.telegraphindia.com/1140403/jsp/you/18146793.jsp |archive-date=29 July 2014 |url-status=dead }} [[V. G. Siddhartha]] started the café chain in 1996 when he incorporated Coffee Day Global, which is the parent of the Coffee Day chain.{{cite news |title=VG Siddhartha: The man who tasted success through coffee |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/food/vg-siddhartha-the-man-who-tasted-success-through-coffee/articleshow/70443514.cms |date=30 July 2019 |publisher=Economic Times |access-date=Jul 30, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190730054853/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/food/vg-siddhartha-the-man-who-tasted-success-through-coffee/articleshow/70443514.cms |archive-date=30 July 2019 |url-status=live }} The first CCD outlet was set up on July 11, 1996, at [[Brigade Road]], [[Bangalore]], [[Karnataka]]. It rapidly expanded to other cities in India, with more than 1,000 cafés open across the nation by 2011. In 2010, it was announced that a consortium led by [[Kohlberg Kravis Roberts]] would invest {{INRConvert|1000|c|lk=|year=2010}} in Coffee Day Resorts, owned by the company.{{cite news |title=KKR-led consortium to invest Rs 1k-cr in Coffee Day Resorts |url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2010-03-15/news/27618290_1_kkr-cafe-coffee-day-coffee-bars |date=15 March 2010 |agency=Economic Times |access-date=Jul 24, 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140708203153/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2010-03-15/news/27618290_1_kkr-cafe-coffee-day-coffee-bars |archive-date=8 July 2014 |url-status=dead }} The same year, the logo was changed to the current logo, which the company stated was to showcase the chain as a place to talk.{{cite news|title=Cafe Coffee Day unveils new logo|url=http://www.deccanherald.com/content/29049/cafe-coffee-day-unveils-logo.html|date=6 October 2010|agency=[[Deccan Herald]]|location=Bangalore|access-date=Jul 24, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140728144351/http://www.deccanherald.com/content/29049/cafe-coffee-day-unveils-logo.html|archive-date=28 July 2014|url-status=live}} This was done with major changes in the layout of the stores, including the addition of lounges and a total revamp of the interiors.{{cite news |title=Cafe Coffee Day to go for makeover, to open 180 outlets this fiscal |url=http://www.dnaindia.com/lifestyle/report-cafe-coffee-day-to-go-for-makeover-to-open-180-outlets-this-fiscal-1402432 |date=28 June 2010 |agency=[[Daily News and Analysis]] |location=Barcelona |access-date=Jul 24, 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140729032157/http://www.dnaindia.com/lifestyle/report-cafe-coffee-day-to-go-for-makeover-to-open-180-outlets-this-fiscal-1402432 |archive-date=29 July 2014 |url-status=live }} Happy Valentine's Day...!.jpg|A cup of coffee at Café Coffee Day Cafecoffeday.JPG|Sandwich, coffee and tea served at CCD The company is vertically integrated as per the strategy to cut costs: from owning the plantations to growing the coffee, making the coffee machines{{cite web|url=http://businesstoday.intoday.in/story/competition-in-coffee-retailing-grows/1/17520.html|title=Competition in the coffee retailing sector steps up|date=18 August 2011 |access-date=22 August 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120115121954/http://businesstoday.intoday.in/story/competition-in-coffee-retailing-grows/1/17520.html|archive-date=15 January 2012|url-status=live}} and making the furniture for the outlets. On 29 July 2019, Siddhartha went missing, and his body was found in the [[Netravati River|Nethravathi river]] backwaters two days later. A letter, assumed to be written by Siddhartha addressing the board of directors and staff, was made public in which he takes responsibility for not creating a profitable business model.{{Cite web |url=https://pixr8.com/news/indias-leading-coffee-chain-cafe-coffee-day-founder-dead-body-found/ |title=India's leading Coffee Chain Cafe Coffee Day founder dead body found |date=31 July 2019 |access-date=31 July 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190731060932/https://pixr8.com/news/indias-leading-coffee-chain-cafe-coffee-day-founder-dead-body-found/ |archive-date=31 July 2019 |url-status=live }} In September 2019, the company appointed auditing firm [[Ernst & Young|Ernst and Young]] to scrutinize their books of accounts. They also indicated the auditor will also look into circumstances of the last letter written by the founder and the points he made in it.{{Cite web|url=https://www.news18.com/news/business/coffee-day-enterprise-appoints-global-accounting-firm-ey-to-scrutnize-book-of-accounts-2263585.html|title=Coffee Day Enterprise Appoints Global Accounting Firm EY to Scrutnise Book of Accounts|website=News18|date=8 August 2019 |access-date=2019-09-03|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190903140818/https://www.news18.com/news/business/coffee-day-enterprise-appoints-global-accounting-firm-ey-to-scrutnize-book-of-accounts-2263585.html|archive-date=3 September 2019|url-status=live}} In March 2020, Coffee Day Enterprises Limited announced that it has reached an agreement to sell Global Village Technology Park, a 90-acre tech park on the outskirts of [[Bengaluru]], for a total consideration of ₹2,700 crore for repaying the debt of Cafe Coffee Day's associate firms and their promoters.{{Cite news|last=Laskar|first=Anirudh|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/coffee-day-gets-rs-1800-crore-from-blackstone-for-it-park-deal-11585319349415.html|title=Coffee Day gets Rs. 1800 crore from Blackstone for IT park deal|date=27 March 2020|work=Live Mint|access-date=29 March 2020}} In 2023, [[IndusInd Bank]] filed a bankruptcy petition against Cafe Coffee Day.{{Cite web |last=Prasad B |first=keshava |date=24 July 2023 |title=ದಿವಾಳಿ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ ಕಾಫಿ ಡೇ ಗ್ಲೋಬಲ್ |url=https://vistaranews.com/commerce/coffee-day-global-coffee-day-global-filed-for-liquidation/408833.html |access-date=24 July 2023 |website=Vistara News}} ==Outlets== Prior to Siddhartha's death in 2018, Coffee Day had nearly 1,700 cafes, 500-plus kiosks, more than 400 Fresh & Ground outlets, and over 47,500 vending machines placed in offices of different companies. {{Cite web |title=V G Siddhartha: Life, Legacy and Lessons of CCD Founder |url=https://www.deccanherald.com/features/v-g-siddhartha-the-man-behind-cafe-coffee-day-and-the-business-he-left-behind-3837276 |access-date=2025-12-29 |website=Deccan Herald |language=en}} As of September 2024, the company had 450 café outlets in 141 cities.{{Cite web |last=Kannan |first=Uma |date=2024-09-04 |title=Cafe Coffee Day’s presence falls to 141 cities, outlets drop to 450 in FY24 |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2024/Sep/04/cafe-coffee-days-presence-falls-to-141-cities-outlets-drop-to-450-in-fy24 |access-date=2025-04-17 |website=The New Indian Express |language=en}} As of September 30, 2025, the cafe count stood at 423 while the vending machine business has survived with 55,733 machines.{{Cite web |title=V G Siddhartha: Life, Legacy and Lessons of CCD Founder |url=https://www.deccanherald.com/features/v-g-siddhartha-the-man-behind-cafe-coffee-day-and-the-business-he-left-behind-3837276 |access-date=2025-12-29 |website=Deccan Herald |language=en}} Café Coffee Day in Kempegowda Airport, Aug 2008.jpg|[[Kempegowda International Airport|Bangalore Airport]] Cafe coffee day cyber hub phase 3.jpg|[[Gurgaon]] Cafe Coffee Day Barkatpura Hyderabad.jpg|[[Hyderabad]] Cafe Coffee Day, Novy Smichov, Prague.jpg|[[Prague]] ==Subsidiaries== In June 2010, CCD acquired Café Emporio, a café chain from the [[Czech Republic]]. At that time, Café Emporio had 11 cafés in the Czech Republic.{{Cite web |url=https://www.deccanherald.com/content/72821/cafe-coffee-day-acquires-cafe.html |title=CCD acquires Czech Republic's Cafe Emporio |access-date=30 March 2020 |date=1 June 2010 }} Café Coffee Day's divisions include: * Coffee Day Fresh 'n' Ground, which owns 375 [[coffee bean]] and powder retail outlets * Coffee Day Square, a high-level coffee bar in [[Bangalore]], [[Kolkata]], [[Chennai]], [[Mumbai]] and [[New Delhi]] * Coffee Day Xpress, which runs 537 Coffee Day kiosks * Coffee Day Beverages, which runs over 56,799 vending machines * Coffee Day Exports, its exporting wing * Coffee Day Perfect, its [[fast-moving consumer goods]] packaged coffee division * Coffee Day B2C Plant, [[coffee vending machine]] manufacturing division ==See also== * [[List of coffeehouse chains]] * [[Tata Starbucks]] {{portal|Coffee}} == Footnotes == {{reflist}}{{commons category|Café Coffee Day}} ==External links== * [https://www.cafecoffeeday.com/ Official website] {{Kohlberg Kravis Roberts}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Cafe Coffee Day}} [[Category:Coffeehouses and cafés in India]] [[Category:Coffee brands]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Privately held companies of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Multinational companies headquartered in India]]
extract: Café Coffee Day (CCD) is an Indian multinational chain of coffeehouses headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka. It is a subsidiary of Coffee Day Enterprises Limited. Internationally, CCD is present in Austria, the Czech Republic, Malaysia, Nepal, and Egypt.
